title: Wow
body: First of all,  I love James Clear. I am considering him a my best friend, even thought I haven’t met him. To think that I can have him as a mentor that provides me new lesson everyday is amazing and for something like 100 dollar a year it’s the best deal in the world. On top of it it helps me showing up, not missed twice, build good habits, track it and have a little progress every day to be the best version of myself. If you read atomic Habits this must have. Thank you James clear and his team for this App.
